C0319.title: Tencent Warns Users Against Bulk Malicious Registration of WeChat Accounts
C0319.summary: In December 2018, Tencent issued a warning that black-market actors were using SIM card vendors and SMS relay platforms to obtain phone numbers and verification codes, then employing tools like modem pools and device farms to register WeChat accounts in bulk for malicious purposes. Such activities may face legal penalties.
